name: AMD Instinct MI350P
memory_bandwidth_basis: '4 TB/s' per the AMD spec table on a 4096-bit interface - exactly half the 8192-bit MI350X/MI355X, with correspondingly half the memory (144GB vs 288GB). The page gives no memory-clock figure for this part, so the 4 TB/s is a vendor figure without published arithmetic. AUDIT VERIFIED: 4096-bit x 8 Gb/s per pin / 8 = 4,000 GB/s, which reconciles exactly with AMD's printed figure. (The generic 'HBM3E = 5.0 Gbps' assumption that a mechanical audit would apply gives 2,560 GB/s and is wrong for this part: MI350-series HBM3E runs at 8 Gb/s per pin, and AMD's own spec table lists 'Memory Clock 8 GHz'.)
notes:
The CDNA4 part you can actually buy as a normal add-in card, and the only CDNA4 SKU without an OAM/8-GPU-platform story. Exactly HALF of an OAM part in every dimension: 128 CUs vs 256, 8192 SPs vs 16,384, 512 matrix cores vs 1024, 73B transistors vs 185B, 144 GB vs 288 GB, 4096-bit vs 8192-bit, 4 TB/s vs 8 TB/s, 128 MB Infinity Cache vs 256 MB.

Note the page does NOT state a release year for MI350P (no 'Launch Date' field), so release_year 2025 is inferred from it shipping alongside the June 2025 MI350 series - treat it as approximate.

Power is the interesting part: 600W max TBP but 450W TBP is configurable, and the card uses a standard 12V-2x6 connector rather than a 54V UBB. That makes it deployable in ordinary air-cooled servers. Passive cooling, full height / 267mm / double slot, Linux x86_64 only.

No Infinity Fabric links are listed on the spec page - scale-up beyond the card is PCIe only. That is a real limitation for multi-GPU inference: the OAM parts get a 153 GB/s scale-up mesh, this card gets PCIe Gen5 x16 (128 GB/s bidirectional) per card.

CDNA4 software surface is confirmed on the product page: OpenMP, OpenCL, HIP, ROCm, TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX-RT, SGLang, JAX, Triton, Kokkos, RAJA. That is the broadest explicitly-listed framework support of any part here and worth noting for inference engine selection.

TF32 is software-emulated on CDNA4. Sparse figures are 2x dense. Two fp16 entries on purpose: 72 TFLOPS vector, 1150 TFLOPS matrix. MXFP6/MXFP4 at 4600 PFLOPs. ROCm LLVM target gfx950.
